design_system.name: Nexus HR
design_system.description: A Swiss-style, high-contrast employee management system that balances corporate precision with human warmth.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and modal titles. Tight tracking (-0.02em) for sizes over 24px.

body.usage: Primary font for all paragraphs, inputs, and data tables.

mono.usage: Use for Contract IDs, Audit Logs, and numerical data requiring alignment.

primary.name: International Klein Blue
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, sidebar background.

gradients.exception: Subtle 'Tracing Beam' effect on active cards only.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (2x standard). Use p-8 or p-12 for main containers.

admin_dashboard.rules: Dense, data-heavy. Widgets must stretch to fill height.

employee_dashboard.rules: Asymmetrical. Mix hero widgets (col-span-8) with small stats (col-span-2).

containers.card_style: Flat, 1px border (border-slate-200), no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-lg and slight lift.
containers.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px) for a technical feel.

buttons.style: Sharp edges or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast text.
buttons.hover: Must change background color significantly, not just opacity.

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:border-transparent rounded-sm

navigation.admin: Sidebar (Left). Dark background (Slate 900) with white text.
navigation.employee: Top Navbar. White background with 1px bottom border. Glassmorphism if sticky.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for 'Action Required' cards (e.g., Pending Contracts).
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Use for Document Management tables to separate rows/cols clearly.

icons.usage: Use specific icons for actions (e.g., 'PenNib' for Sign, 'FolderOpen' for Docs).

hero_bg.description: Modern office hallway, use for Login/Register background with overlay.

admin_header.description: Boardroom, use for Admin Dashboard welcome section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use Slate-900 on Slate-50.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' theme. Avoid gradients.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Figtree' for body text.
Create two distinct layouts: Sidebar for Admin, Top-nav for Employee.
Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds and avatars. DO NOT use placeholders.
Implement 'Tracing Beam' effect for the 'Sign Contract' card.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Shadcn components but override rounded-lg with rounded-sm for a sharper look.
For the Document Management section, use a dense table layout with visible grid borders.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
